title: Studio Memberships with Raku and Electric Kilns
summary: Memberships at three Seattle locations (Green Lake, Capitol Hill, Madison Park) provide 24/7 studio access including electric and raku kilns for low and mid-range firings (10-day turnaround), plus members-only workshops.
source_quote: Electric and raku kilns for low and mid-range firings with a 10-day turnaround
evidence_sentence: The memberships page states members have access to electric and raku kilns for firing their work.
